about_the_game:
A mesmerizing HD-2D world brought to life with dynamic lighting—where every scene shifts in tone and atmosphere with the passage of time.

This ARPG blends a carefully crafted linear narrative with light roguelike elements, offering both a polished main story and the thrill of randomized exploration. Will you master its challenges and uncover the secrets hidden in the light and shadow?

The Demon King is dead - killed by your hands, hero. But you don't remember anything.

You are deprived of your power by a mysterious curse and you wake up to a world that is still shrouded in darkness. The tyrant is gone, why is peace still out of reach? Regain your strength and piece together forgotten truths from ancient texts and people of all personalities to unravel your true memories.

Rich story content and the master of fate

Wield the power of 'Pacts'—unbreakable contracts that bind both parties to their terms. But first, you must tempt each character's deepest desires to manifest them.

With rich dialogue choices, every conversation becomes a strategic game. Your words shape not only the Pacts you forge, but also your own morality and personality. Will you exploit their yearnings... or guide them toward redemption?

Strategy, battle with equal emphasis on equipment and operation

Engage in fast-paced real-time combat—dodging, parrying, and striking with precision—but with a tactical twist!

While mastering movement is key, the game emphasizes smart team synergy over punishing reflexes. With 4 unique playable characters, mix and match battle styles: from high-risk 'glass cannon' builds to unshakable 'tank' strategies, or even tag-team 'relay' tactics. Elemental strengths and weaknesses ensure no single strategy dominates.

(Note: As the game is still in development, more combat details will be revealed soon! Stay tuned for deeper mechanics.)

short_description: Pleas,desires,cravings...The human heart knows no bounds,and the reasons are legion. To judge or to bless?The choice is yours to wield! In this ARPG,you hold the power to shape destinies,but only with the courage to conquer formidable foes. At the edge of memory,the truth of this world awaits...
